CreateC2paSignTask.description_en: Creates a C2PA content credential signing task for a JPEG or PNG file
CreateC2paSignTask.description_zh: 为JPEG或PNG文件创建符合C2PA标准的内容凭证签名任务

CreateImageDetectionTask.description_en: Creates an asynchronous image tampering detection task and returns the task ID
CreateImageDetectionTask.description_zh: 用于创建异步图片篡改检测任务，返回任务ID

CreateImageTask.description_en: Generates images based on a provided text description and returns a task ID
CreateImageTask.description_zh: 根据提供的文字描述生成图片，并返回任务ID

CreateSensitiveScanTask.description_en: Creates an image sensitive information scan task and returns the task ID
CreateSensitiveScanTask.description_zh: 用于创建图片敏感信息扫描任务并返回任务ID

DetectAigcImage.description_en: Determines whether an image is AI-generated and returns detection labels and confidence levels
DetectAigcImage.description_zh: 判断图片是否由AI生成，并返回检测标签及置信度

DetectImageBasicInfo.description_en: Retrieves basic information about a specified image, such as the file name, format, size, and resolution
DetectImageBasicInfo.description_zh: 获取指定图片的文件名、格式、大小和分辨率等基本信息

GetC2paSignResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of a C2PA content credential signing task
GetC2paSignResult.description_zh: 查询C2PA内容凭证签名任务的状态和结果

GetImageDetectionTaskResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of an image detection task created by CreateImageDetectionTask
GetImageDetectionTaskResult.description_zh: 查询通过CreateImageDetectionTask创建的图片检测任务的状态和结果

GetImageTaskResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of an asynchronous image generation task and retrieves the image download URL
GetImageTaskResult.description_zh: 查询异步图片生成任务的状态和结果，获取图片下载地址

GetSensitiveScanResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of a sensitive information scan task and returns the details of the sensitive data discovered during the scan
GetSensitiveScanResult.description_zh: 查询敏感信息扫描任务的状态和结果，返回扫描发现的敏感数据详情

SignUserImage.description_en: Embeds a C2PA digital signature into a user-uploaded image and returns the download URL
SignUserImage.description_zh: 对用户上传的图片嵌入C2PA数字签名并返回下载地址

VerifyImageSignature.description_en: Verifies the C2PA digital signature in an image and returns the signature status and issuer information
VerifyImageSignature.description_zh: 验证图片中的C2PA数字签名，返回签名状态及签发者信息
